descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT, Servicii de date pentru sisteme IT și Operațiuni și întreținere pentru sisteme IT
Main responsibilities:
 1. Be responsible for the daily maintenance and management of the cloud platform, ensuring its smooth operation.
 2. Monitor the usage of cloud resources, identify and resolve basic faults and performance issues.
 3. Implement security policies for the cloud environment and assist in ensuring data and system security.
 4. Provide user support to solve common problems encountered by users during use.
 5. Assist in writing and updating cloud operation and maintenance documents to ensure their accuracy.
 6. Cooperate with senior engineers and other IT teams to configure and integrate the cloud platform.
 Job Requirements:
 Educational Background:
 1. Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Information Technology or related fields (equivalent overseas qualifications).
 Work Experience:
 1. More than 3 years of experience in cloud platform operation and maintenance, familiar with mainstream cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure.
 Certification Requirements:
 1. Prior certifications in AWS or Azure cloud-related fields are preferred.
 Skills Requirements:
 1. Familiar with the basic architecture design and operation management of cloud platforms and containerization.
 2. Master basic cloud resource monitoring, performance optimization, and troubleshooting techniques.
 3. Possess good security policy implementation capabilities to assist in ensuring the security of the cloud environment.
 4. Have good communication skills and teamwork spirit, and be able to effectively collaborate with other team members.
 5. Have the ability to write documents, and be able to assist in writing and maintaining cloud operation documentation.
